verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents its own Go package, tsnet, for embedding Tailscale inside a Go program, so there is a first-party SDK to build against. The evidence is a single thin mention covering one language, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Go (e.g. Python/TypeScript API clients), in-depth SDK reference documentation, a published OpenAPI spec or generated API client libraries, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the tsnet package to embed Tailscale inside a Go program.
